mapper.select: SELECT rt.id, rt.token, rt.user_id, rt.expires_at, rt.revoked, rt.created_at, u.id AS u_id, u.email AS u_email, u.password AS u_password, u.name AS u_name, u.created_at AS u_created_at, u.password_changed_at AS u_password_changed_at, u.enabled AS u_enabled FROM pjt_refresh_tokens rt JOIN pjt_users u ON u.id = rt.user_id WHERE rt.id = #{id}

SELECT rt.id, rt.token, rt.user_id, rt.expires_at, rt.revoked, rt.created_at, u.id AS u_id, u.email AS u_email, u.password AS u_password, u.name AS u_name, u.created_at AS u_created_at, u.password_changed_at AS u_password_changed_at, u.enabled AS u_enabled FROM pjt_refresh_tokens rt JOIN pjt_users u ON u.id = rt.user_id WHERE rt.token = #{token}
mapper.update: UPDATE pjt_refresh_tokens SET revoked = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pjt_refresh_tokens (token, user_id, expires_at, revoked, created_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked}, #{createdAt})
